item.title: identifying multi-word-expressions with quanteda textstats
item.description: I am currently preparing my tokens for topic-modeling with R. I want to identify multi-word expressions with Dunning's G² score using quanteda textstats. How should the values lambda and z be interpreted? Is there a cut-off value? You have refrences to sources to scientific papers? Thank you!
